items.title: Revised floor plan from Dana
items.quote: I'll have the revised floor plan to you by the end of the month
items.date_text: by the end of the month
items.note: Written by Dana, not the user: 'I'll' belongs to the sender. 'end of the month' names a period, so the date is Assumed (inferred).

items.title: Confirm the tile color
items.quote: Could you confirm the tile color by next Friday?
items.note: Project rule (tests/unit/resolveDates.test.ts): 'next Friday' is the Friday after the coming one. Written Mon Oct 12, so Fri Oct 23, not Oct 16.

items.title: Pay the cabinet deposit
items.quote: the cabinet deposit of $1,850 is due Thursday
items.note: Amount copied exactly as written. Could also be typed request; evals/run.ts does not score type.

items.title: Ruth to check the electrical panel
items.quote: Ruth Kamau, said she'll stop by to check the panel on Oct 16
items.note: Month-day with no year, 4 days ahead of the written-on date: this year (D28).
